variants.title: Aching Back
variants.premise: He's hunched over a heavy crate, easing it down onto the dock.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any ships heading out of the harbour?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask the tide, not me, iknami.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He straightens up slowly, hand pressed to his back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They'll sail all right. Just not with you aboard.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Says who?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No idea. Above my pay, and my pay's already rubbish.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'd have to prove yourself first. No idea how.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Every day's rough when you lift crates for a living.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Suppose so.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind how you go.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Wise choice.

variants.title: Counting Coins
variants.premise: He's counting coins a ship's crew just paid him for unloading cargo.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can I catch a ride out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ha. Wish I could tell you yes.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He pockets the coins and nods towards the moored ships.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Aldarin crews tip well. The rest never do.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: But can any of them sail me out?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Not one. None of them will vouch for a stranger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Some registrar up in the dock building. Never met her.

options.label: Any good crews to work for?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Aldarin lot, if you don't mind heavy lifting.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Noted.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Suit yourself.

variants.title: Quiver Spotted
variants.premise: He's stacking barrels by the charter dock, checking the tide table.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a ship out of Varlamore.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He spots Dizana's quiver and stops mid-lift.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Tetamo... that's a Colosseum quiver, that is.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Does that mean something?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Means you've earned your ticket. Go find the registrar.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: She keeps the ledger. Ask her, not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Right there, past the crates. Can't miss it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't thank me, thank your own arms.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Ha.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go on, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Make it quick, I've crates waiting.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Never mind.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva, then.
